verdict.rationale: Mirrors references reviewing agent sessions, previewing routing conditions against stored traces, and recorded sessions. It also says it works with the traces a team already has and lists agent frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph. However, the evidence suggests Mirrors consumes existing traces rather than instrumenting runs itself, and nothing describes nested span hierarchies or thread grouping. Missing for 10: first-party instrumentation/SDK for capturing multi-step runs, nested parent/child span model, explicit session/thread grouping docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
